text:
maria: Posting Osiris postmortem follow-ups 10m read. Root cause summary: MTU/fragmentation mismatch across customer on-prem NAT appliances + opportunistic PMTU blackhole resulted in gRPC frames being dropped and the Dedicated pool treating connections as half-open, triggering eviction cascades and temporary tenant isolation.

lina: Thanks. Can you list the concrete action items so we can move them into the sprint board?

maria: Sure. I distilled them to 4 workstreams + customer comms.

kevin-runtime: I'll take runtime changes (INF-5001). Plan: add graceful connection quiesce + explicit PMTU probe/validation on new peered connections, and a fallback short-lived TCP reconnect window to avoid mass eviction. Prototype this week.

devex: I'll build a harness that injects MTU drop and simulates blackhole PMTU behavior (INF-5002). Will wire it into the nightly regression runner so we catch regressions.

lina: On infra, I'll own route & peering config hardening (INF-5003). Tasks: add PMTU-aware routes, enable ECN where supported, and add a small health-check TCP probe that fails fast if fragment losses exceed threshold. Target PR by Friday.

infra-bot: ticket INF-5003 created by lina.

maria: Customer comms: I'll draft a postmortem summary for Osiris and recommend a change window for their NAT team to validate PMTU and enable path MTU discovery. Ticket INF-5004 for comms/coordination.

kevin-runtime: Proposed runtime checklist items:
- detect sustained ICMP/PTB loss for 30s -> mark connection as PMTU-unknown
- run 3 active PMTU probes (sizes: 1500, 1400, 1300) with 2s timeout
- if probe fails, switch to 1300 with sticky flag for 5m before retry
- avoid mass eviction: staggered recon and per-tenant backoff

kevin-runtime: quick patch snippet for graceful drain hook:

```
# pseudo
def on_peer_route_change(peer):
    for conn in active_conns.to_peer(peer):
        conn.mark_draining()
        schedule(conn.force_close, delay=rand(3,8))
```

devex: For the harness I'll add two tests: (1) forced PMTU blackhole causing fragmentation drop and assert no tenant-wide eviction; (2) intermittent small packet loss with high p99 latency and assert connection quiesce recovers without reroute. Will add assertions into CI: max 1 eviction per 10k reqs.

lina: Ops plan: require a 90-min maintenance window for the infra change; canary first 10% of peered prefixes, watch for increased TCP resets. Rollback: revert route PMTU enforcement and toggle ECN off. Proposed window: Sat 01:00-02:30 UTC.

maria: Success criteria (to be attached to each ticket):
- No tenant isolation measured in synthetic PMTU blackhole for 10m after changes
- Eviction rate <= 0.0002 (evictions per request) in canary for 30m
- PMTU probe latency < 200ms and reconvergence within 20s
- Customer confirms NAT PMTU validation steps in their ticket within 3 business days

kevin-runtime: Logging/metrics we need: pmtu_probe.count, pmtu_probe.fail_rate, conn.drain.start_ts, conn.force_close_count. I'll add these to INF-5001.

infra-bot: New tickets: INF-5001 (runtime), INF-5002 (harness), INF-5003 (infra), INF-5004 (customer-comms).

maria: I've put the tickets into the "osiris-remediation" epic and created a short runbook for oncall to follow during the canary: https://redwood.infra/postmortems/osiris-2026-runbook (draft).

devex: Thu 10am PT sync to hand off infra/runtime/harness artifacts? I can demo the harness then.

lina: Thu 10am PT works. I'll bring the canary gating plan and rollback steps.

sre-oncall: I'll be on rotation for the canary. Few operational notes: please include a log extract to quickly check per-tenant eviction spikes and a Kibana dashboard link in the PR.

maria: Will add the dashboard and a saved query: 

kql: 
message:eviction AND tenant_id:* AND timestamp:[now-30m TO now]

maria: Additional preventive proposal: add a monthly incident-pattern scan (INF-5005) that searches for MTU/fragmentation indicators across dedicated/onprem incidents and surfaces customers with repeated blackhole symptoms. Aj suggested something similar previously.

kevin-runtime: Timeline recap:
- INF-5002 (harness) -> devex mock harness Thu AM, CI integration Fri
- INF-5001 (runtime) -> prototype Thu, PR Mon, canary after infra change
- INF-5003 (infra) -> PR Fri, deploy Sat 01:00-02:30 UTC canary
- INF-5004 (comms) -> maria to send initial customer note Mon EOD

maria: Thanks. If anyone needs to reassign owners or change windows, reply in-thread. Will move tickets to the sprint and send calendar invite for Thu sync. :white_check_mark:
